Job Introduction
Help shape the future of bus travel across the West Midlands. We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst who enjoys solving problems, improving how things work and putting customers at the heart of change.
At Transport for West Midlands (TfWM), we're working towards a new era of bus services through our Bus Reform programme. This is an opportunity to help develop the processes, systems and ways of working needed to deliver a successful, customer-first bus franchising across the region.
You'll work closely with colleagues, technical specialists and stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement and translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
Please note, this is an 18 month FTC. First stage MS Teams interviews are likely to take place w.c. 21st December, with final stage interviews concluding in the new year.

What you will be doing
• Work with stakeholders across the Bus Reform programme to gather, analyse and document business requirements, translating them into clear functional specifications and technical requirements.
• Map and evaluate existing business processes, identifying opportunities to simplify ways of working, improve efficiency and develop future processes that support successful bus franchising.
• Work with colleagues and stakeholders to understand customer and service-user needs.
• Use business analysis techniques, data and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for improvement, automation and more effective service delivery.
• Contribute to solution development, testing and implementation, ensuring changes meet business requirements and deliver their intended benefits.
• Build strong relationships with project teams, technical specialists, suppliers and stakeholders.

What's essential
• Proven Business Analysis experience.
• Experience working within a team of Business Analysts on projects of varying sizes.
• Understanding of and experience in the full Business Analysis role across project lifecycles, including pre-project, scoping, estimating, mapping, stakeholder analysis, requirements gathering, solution analysis, product analysis, user acceptance testing and release management.
• Experience of business process modelling and optimisation tools and techniques.
• Experience supporting the transition from As-Is processes to To-Be ways of working.
• Proven experience identifying potential solutions and assessing the suitability of emerging technologies.
• A track record of building rapport and excellent relationships with a range of stakeholders.
• Experience identifying opportunities while evaluating and mitigating issues and risks.
• Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Ability to identify and resolve issues experienced by customer leads and end users.
• Ability to work under broad direction in challenging environments, influencing strategic decision-making.
• Ability to manage concurrent schedules and tight deadlines, delivering on time, within budget and to scope.
• A-level qualifications or equivalent.
Please refer to the JD for a full list of essential criteria.

Location
16 Summer Lane, Birmingham, with at least 2 days a week spent in the office.

How to apply
• Create your Careers Account.
• Build your Profile (upload your CV to populate career and education details).
• Write your Supporting Statement addressing each essential criterion.
• Submit your application.
WMCA may close the vacancy early once it has enough applications. The process is anonymised: only the information in your profile is used for shortlisting. Applications that rely too heavily on AI may be rejected.

Salary and benefits
New appointments typically start at the lowest salary point. Local Government Pension Scheme, 28 days leave plus statutory days, EV car scheme, healthcare plans, 3 volunteering days and other benefits.

Sponsorship / Right to work requirements
Skilled Worker visa sponsorship will only be considered for roles that meet defined business-critical criteria. This role does not meet that threshold and WMCA is unable to offer sponsorship. Applicants must have the appropriate right to work in the UK before applying.

Redeployment
Priority consideration may be given to colleagues at risk of redundancy; the vacancy may close early if a redeployment candidate is found.

Start your career in card payments with a fast-growing payments business
We're partnering with a growing card payments business, with acquiring and issuing operations, to hire a Chargeback Operations Junior Analyst for its Risk Operations team.
This is a hands-on role for someone who likes detail and wants to build a long-term career in chargebacks, disputes and fraud. You'll work closely with the Chargeback & Fraud Manager and see the full dispute lifecycle across Visa and Mastercard.
What you'll be doing
• Chargeback case handling: reviewing and processing chargeback cases accurately, following internal procedures and card scheme rules, and keeping to scheme deadlines.
• Evidence packs: putting together evidence and supporting documents that win cases, and making sure they're complete and submitted on time.
• Mastercard Collaboration: reviewing Mastercard Collaboration reports every day, picking out the cases that need action and making sure each one is dealt with quickly.
• Visa Verifi: helping onboard new clients onto Visa Verifi (including connecting terminals), monitoring daily Verifi reports and acting on them.
• Merchant and client contact: talking to clients and merchants to agree whether to defend or accept a dispute, then processing any refunds that follow.
• Reporting: producing daily chargeback reports for merchants and daily transaction data for the Finance team.
• Fraud monitoring: tracking daily fraud levels, spotting unusual trends, and helping prepare and deliver fraud analysis reports to clients.
• Records and escalation: keeping clear, auditable case records, and flagging anything unusual, incomplete or outside procedure to the Chargeback & Fraud Manager.
What we're looking for
• Some experience in chargebacks, disputes, fraud operations, payments, banking or another detail-heavy operational role. Strong transferable experience is welcome too.
• Excellent attention to detail. Accuracy really matters here.
• Good organisation, with the ability to handle several cases, reports and deadlines at once.
• Confident written and spoken communication with merchants, clients and colleagues.
• Comfortable in Excel (filtering, sorting, reconciliation, basic analysis) and quick to pick up new systems.
• Good with numbers, with a real interest in spotting patterns in chargeback and fraud data.
• You take ownership of your work, follow things through, and know when to escalate.
Nice to have
• Experience at a card acquirer, issuer, payment processor or fintech.
• Knowledge of Visa and Mastercard chargeback processes, reason codes and evidence requirements.
• Hands-on use of Mastercom/Mastercard Collaboration, Visa Verifi (RDR / CDRN / Order Insight) or a similar dispute-management or case-management platform.
• Experience producing operational, financial, chargeback or fraud reports.
Why apply?
• A real first step, or next step, into chargebacks, fraud and card payments, with exposure across both acquiring and issuing.
• Learn directly from an experienced Chargeback & Fraud Manager inside a close-knit Risk Operations team.
• A scaling business where good work gets noticed and there's room to grow into more senior risk, fraud or disputes roles.
Interested?
If you have the required skills and experience for this role then please apply today and if considered suitable our specialist consultant will be in touch.

jd_full:
About Precision Management Consulting
Precision Management Consulting helps small and medium sized businesses fix how they run. We use our 5M methodology: Map the business, Measure its numbers, Model the options, Modify how it operates and Maintain the results. Our clients are owner run businesses with messy data and real cash pressure. We help them understand where profit and cash are going and what to do about it.

The role
You will work on client engagements across all five Ms. The core of the job is financial analysis and financial modelling, supported by clear process modelling. You will turn a client's accounts, ledgers and operational data into a clear picture, then explain it simply to the business owner.

How you will work across the 5 Ms
Map: Understand how the client's business actually runs, from enquiry to cash.
• Draw swimlane and activity diagrams of the key processes
• Pull together data from accounting systems, CRMs and job records, and model how it connects
• Spot where work, time and money leak
Measure: Find out where profit and cash are going.
• Analyse profit and loss accounts, balance sheets and ledgers, including gross margins and overheads
• Link profit to cash: how debtors, creditors, VAT, loans and dividends move cash
• Reconcile ledgers to bank statements, flag discrepancies, and draw clear conclusions
Model: Show the client what could happen next.
• Build financial models and projections, including profit and loss and cash flow forecasts
• Test options such as pricing, headcount and collection of debtors
• Explain the assumptions in plain English
Modify: Change how the business operates, so the improvements are real.
• Turn the findings into action plans with owners and dates
• Manage the projects: monitor progress, follow up, and keep the client accountable
• Report on results and adjust the plan
Maintain: Keep the improvements in place.
• Prepare monthly management accounts and run reviews with the client
• Run variance analysis against the plan, track KPIs and update forecasts
• Coach the client to stay on track, and keep the models and process maps current
Across all five Ms, you will present findings to clients, guide them through next steps, and use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to work faster, checking and explaining everything they produce.

What we are looking for
• A solid understanding of finance: double entry bookkeeping, gross margin, overheads, and how to read a profit and loss account and balance sheet
• Experience in financial analysis and building models in Excel
• Basic process modelling, including UML style swimlane or activity diagrams
• Experience managing projects: planning actions, monitoring progress and keeping to dates
• An excellent communication style: you can explain complex ideas in simple terms to people who are not finance specialists, in writing and live
• Hands on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, and the ability to verify and explain what they produce
• Fluent business English, written and spoken

Nice to have
• An accounting or finance qualification, or study towards one
• Experience with Xero, QuickBooks or similar accounting systems
• Experience working with SMEs or in consulting

Pay: From £35,000.00 per year
Work Location: Remote

jd_full:
Job Title: Customer Operations Analyst
Employment type: Permanent, hybrid (3 days per week in our Manchester office)
Salary: £26,227.50 per annum

At AccessPay, we believe that great technology starts with great people. We're a leading fintech helping organisations streamline payments and cash management. Recognised as one of the UK's Best Workplaces.
We're looking for a proactive and customer-focused individual to join our fast-paced Customer Operations team. In this role, you'll manage customer queries, provide first-line support, and carry out operational activities to deliver an efficient, high-quality service. You'll take ownership of issues from investigation through to resolution, prioritising your workload effectively and ensuring customers are kept informed throughout.
The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with systems and processes, confident learning new technologies, and able to troubleshoot problems logically. You'll be naturally curious and proactive, taking the initiative to find solutions, improve ways of working, and identify opportunities to enhance both the customer and team experience.

Key Responsibilities
• Managing customer service requests and communications, ensuring tickets are prioritised and progressed within agreed SLAs.
• Taking ownership of customer issues from initial investigation through to resolution, providing clear and timely updates throughout.
• Completing operational activities such as supporting post-release testing.
• Managing and implementing client change requests, including user interface changes, and coordinating with users to verify and address feedback promptly.
• Developing knowledge of our products, systems and processes and using this knowledge to resolve increasingly complex customer queries.
• Creating and maintaining customer and internal documentation, training materials and process guides.
• Collaborating with other teams to optimise operational efficiency.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• Strong customer service and communication skills
• A proactive approach to problem solving
• Strong organisation and prioritisation skills
• Previous experience in a customer support, customer operations, service desk or technology-based role would be advantageous.
• Experience using Zendesk, Salesforce, Atlassian or Jira would be advantageous, but is not essential.

Why join us?
• 25 days' holiday plus public holidays, increasing with length of service; birthday off
• 2 paid volunteer days a year; holiday purchase scheme
• Salary exchange pension scheme from day one
• £240 yearly wellbeing allowance; health cash plan
• Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave; cycle to work scheme
• Free breakfast and lunch in the Manchester office; discounted parking
• Access to internal and external training; dog-friendly office

About AccessPay
AccessPay leads the way in payments operations excellence for finance and treasury teams. Its cloud-based platform connects corporates to their banks, automates bank statement retrieval, and de-risks payments operations through Account Name Verification and Sanctions Screening. 1,000+ customers integrate their ERPs with over 16,000 banks.

Base pay: £26k/yr (employer provided), Manchester.

IN SHORT
SEFE is looking for an organised, proactive and collaborative Onboarding Analyst to support the onboarding of counterparties, brokers, trading products and market activities across its Commercial business.
The role sits at the centre of a fast-paced trading environment and manages onboarding requests from initiation through to operational readiness, working with Front Office, Legal, Credit, Compliance, KYC, ESG, Operations and Technology teams.

WHAT WILL YOU DO
• Manage onboarding pipelines, trackers and workflow tools, ensuring activities are accurately tracked and prioritised.
• Monitor onboarding milestones, risks, dependencies and outstanding actions, escalating issues where required.
• Coordinate information gathering and onboarding activities across internal and external stakeholders.
• Produce onboarding reporting and management information to support decision-making and prioritisation.
• Maintain accurate onboarding records and supporting documentation, ensuring audit readiness and data integrity.
• Identify and implement improvements to onboarding processes, workflows, controls and systems.

WHAT WILL YOU BRING
• Experience in onboarding operations, client onboarding, business support or a similar coordination role, ideally within energy trading, commodities, financial services or capital markets.
• Knowledge of counterparty onboarding, KYC requirements, legal documentation and client lifecycle management processes.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail.
• Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to counterparty onboarding.
• Strong Microsoft Office skills and the ability to work across multiple systems.

ABOUT US
SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, spanning origination, trading, sales, transport and storage, employing over 2,000 people and owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

OUR BENEFITS
Competitive starting salary, hybrid working, bonus potential, non-contributory pension with 10% employer contribution, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days, life assurance, medical and dental insurance.

Salary: £50,964 - £60,899 + a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.
Working Pattern: Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available

The Role
As Product Analyst with a focus on Data, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the direction of our Data products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including business stakeholders, engineers, delivery leads to ensure the successful development, implementation, and optimization of Data solutions.

You Will
• Elicit, analyse, and document business, product, and data requirements across SSE's data platforms through workshops and stakeholder engagement, translating them into user stories, data flows, and functional specifications.
• Partner closely with Product Owners, data engineers, analysts, and delivery teams to refine and prioritise backlogs, ensuring alignment with SSE's data strategy, regulatory needs, and business outcomes.
• Knowledge of Data Facts and Dimensions; able to create mapping documents taking raw data sets and combining them to create re-usable data products and models.
• Support testing and validation of data pipelines, transformations, and analytics outputs, ensuring accuracy, lineage, and compliance with SSE's data governance and quality standards.
• Produce clear, actionable insights for a wide range of stakeholders using tools such as Power BI, Databricks, SQL and Python. Supporting operational, commercial, and strategic decision-making.

You Have
• Proven experience as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst working on data-enabled products within a complex, enterprise environment.
• Strong understanding of data platforms and analytics concepts, including datasets, metrics, data models, and data quality management.
• Hands-on experience with modern data and reporting tools, such as Databricks, SQL, Python or similar cloud-based data query languages.
• Solid knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience using tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira in a product-led environment.
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex data and technical concepts into clear, value-driven outcomes for business and technology teams.

About SSE
SSE's purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers. Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030.
Our IT division powers growth across all SSE business areas by making sure we have the systems, software and security needed to take the lead in a low carbon world. They provide expertise, advice and day-to-day support in emerging technologies, data and analytics, cyber security and more.

Flexible benefits to fit your life
Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

Work with an equal opportunity employer
SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive.

Ready to apply?
Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. jd_full:
Maternity Cover - Expected up to 12 months
Location: Central London, St Paul's (Hybrid) - £27K
Purpose
Market Size Analysts are responsible for creating market size data and content for Mintel's Market Dynamics product. They collect consumer spending and consumption data through both primary and secondary research, interpret and structure complex findings into Mintel's market size databases and produce content that highlights key market data, emerging trends, cross-category, cross-market, and cross-product analyses.
Impact
The data and content produced by the Market Size Analyst will enhance Mintel's market size database and support the development of the Market Dynamics product.
What You Will Be Doing
• Secondary Research: Conduct economic market research across 40 FMCG categories by identifying and utilising secondary sources available in the local market to determine market sizes. Map the brand landscape, presenting findings in structured data formats.
• Trade Interviews: Build and maintain relationships with industry experts and conduct trade interviews, capture emerging trends and key insights.
• Produce written content: Develop category content by applying strong market knowledge and analytical skills to evaluate data outputs, generating insights and reliable market forecasts.
• Communication & collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to share industry expertise.
What We Are Looking For
Local Market Expertise:
• Minimum of 3 years of residency in Italy with a strong understanding of its business culture and consumer behavior.
• Native fluency in both written and spoken Italian is essential.
• Familiarity with FMCG markets and local retail structures is a strong advantage
Data-Driven:
• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with high attention to detail.
• Comfortable working with large sets of quantitative data from various sources.
• Proficiency in Excel and written business English for data analysis and reporting.
Open & Global Mindset:
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with confidence in conducting daily trade interviews via phone or Microsoft Teams.
• Experience in outbound calling (e.g., for sales, research, or customer service) is a plus.
• Collaborative approach in a global environment.
Self-Directed & Proactive:
• Ability to take the initiative to solve problems and take ownership of projects.
• Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Growth-Oriented:
• Commitment to continuous learning and personal development.
What you'll get in return
• Company-wide hybrid working week; flexi-time (start between 7:00am and 11:00am)
• Home office allowance; generous holiday with buy-back option; birthday day off
• 2 volunteering days per year; social events

Job Code: 15656
Job title: Treasury Business Analyst
Job Type: Temporary (PAYE). Contract Duration: 9 Months
Department: Finance
Location: London
Company overview
Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions, with three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking).
Department Overview
Treasury Planning and Analysis comprises four key sub-areas: EMEA Liquidity Risk Policy (LRP), Data Assurance (Data), Regulatory Reporting & Controls (RRP) and Treasury Chief Operating Officer/Office (Treasury COO). Treasury COO is a key component of the Finance Treasury Department.
Overview
The Business Analysts (BA) in the Treasury COO team are based onshore and offshore. The BA process involves regular project updates (daily/weekly) and monthly change control governance. The BA team are responsible for the gap analysis, requirements gathering, solution design, UAT and documentation of data and calculation system changes and transformation. The successful candidate will take responsibility for the delivery of numerous firm-wide data and calculation change and transformation initiatives to enhance front-to-back Treasury and Finance data and system capabilities. This role requires a mixture of Treasury SME, Data and BA skillsets, working with colleagues in London, Tokyo, Singapore, US and Mumbai.
Specific responsibilities:
• Lead front-to-back data and systems change and transformation for Treasury from data and calculation as well as from a reporting perspective, including taking necessary operational decisions and integration with other departments
• Ensure changes are standardised and aligned for both internal and regulatory liquidity reporting
• Support end to end testing (Dev, SIT & UAT)
• Prepare, present and recommend items for approval in technical design and data governance forums as well as Global Liquidity SteerCo
• Engage with Liquidity policy and reporting SMEs, RRP, FiR and FLM teams based in numerous locations globally
• Work closely with upstream data providers to identify trusted data, validate and analyse data changes and resolve data quality issues
• Advance tactical and strategic data quality remediation and validations, holding upstream providers to account
• Perform analysis into data quality issue root causes and new product / business process, ensuring all downstream implications are understood
• Monitor data quality controls associated with the inputs and outputs from the risk systems, including reporting against the firm's KRI framework
• Support product SMEs in identifying the trusted source of data for liquidity reporting, agreeing and checking mitigating controls with manual data providers
• Build strong relationships with Front Office, Product Control, Risk, Legal, IT and Senior Management
Key objectives critical to success:
• Ability to work to high degree of accuracy with logical and structured approach
• Ability to self-review, identify issues and investigate / escalate appropriately
• Willingness and ability to learn new tools and deep dive into underlying codes/scripts/data
• Ability to communicate effectively and build relationships within the department and across functions
• Ability to document effectively key processes
Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:
• Liquidity experience gained in an Investment banking environment performing front-to-back data and system change and transformation
• Knowledge of PRA (UK Basel 3) & EBA (CRRII) Liquidity reporting rules (LCR, NSFR, ALMM, Asset Encumbrance, TWD, RRP, FiR)
• Familiarity with JFSA Basel III Liquidity rules would be a distinct advantage
• Investment banking product knowledge (Secured/Unsecured Financing transactions & Derivatives) including front-to-back trade lifecycle knowledge and its impact on Liquidity reporting
• Ability to connect data to liquidity risk management
• Ability to understand and challenge the detail
• Strong analytical/numerical/problem solving/investigative skills
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Excellent organisational and planning skills, with proven track record of delivery
• Strong documentation skills (e.g. JIRAs, Confluence, Github)
• Exceptional drive, motivation and commitment and focus in operational excellence
• Good IT literacy, with a strong Data Analysis skillset
• Familiar with Investment Banking systems and data management techniques
• Familiarity with big data analytics/business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx) and data frameworks (e.g. Hadoop, MAPR, MinIO) would be a distinct advantage
• Familiarity with coding tools (e.g. Python, SQL) would be a distinct advantage
• Results focused in a pressurised environment with tight project deadlines
Right to Work
The UK Government have taken steps to reduce net migration to the UK by limiting the number of overseas workers coming to the UK for employment. Please note that whilst we are able to consider applications from overseas workers from outside the UK (who require a Tier 2 Skilled Worker visa) we can only employ them if we can provide evidence that this is a genuine vacancy for a qualified role.
Nomura is an equal opportunity employer.

jd_full:
OVERVIEW
The selected candidate will arm the marketing team and wider Portman business with the data and recommendations needed to improve the effectiveness of campaigns through analysis, segmentation, research and profiling.
The main purpose of the role will be:
• Systematic reporting of campaigns and business trends to spot opportunities for improvement and therefore increased revenue;
• Segmentation to identify opportunities for effective personalised messaging with the aim of increased conversion;
• Customer research and profiling with the aim of improving the relevancy of messaging and therefore conversion.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Responsible for providing the Head of Marketing, Marketing team and wider business with campaign analysis and market intelligence designed to improve the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.
• Replace ad-hoc analysis designed to answer specific one-time questions, with systematic monitoring, so that campaign performance can be more clearly tracked, trends and opportunities can be identified and exploited.
Campaign Analysis
The candidate will need to gather information on all aspects of marketing campaigns, ensuring measurability is built into the campaign itself, with the aim of determining an ROI per channel and per campaign. This will typically involve collating information from email, social, direct mail and advertising channels via our analytics platform and producing a summary report with recommendations.
Segmentation
• Create customer segmentations, identifying groups of customers whose patterns or characteristics make viable sales opportunities.
• Work with the tech team to add tested and productive segmentation types to the CRM.
• Produce campaign contact lists for email and direct mail channels.
• Advise on targeting for digital advertising audiences.
• Investigate and make recommendations.
Research
• Competitors - what are they doing?
• Lenders - what are they offering?
• Customers - what do they think and need? Create customer profiles representing the buyers of different products or from different market sectors to improve messaging and targeting.
Software in use: Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics. Excel.

As a values-led Adult Social Care provider we are seeking an experienced Compliance & Data Analyst to join our Team.
Salary: £30,000. Hours: Full time/37 hours per week
Job Purpose
The Compliance and Data Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the organisation maintains high standards of regulatory compliance, data accuracy, and operational efficiency, monitoring care delivery data, compliance metrics, and risk trends in line with CQC regulations, and producing actionable insights to drive continuous improvement. The postholder will work closely with the Registered Manager.
Compliance Monitoring & Governance
• Monitor organisational compliance against CQC standards, internal policies, contractual obligations, and safeguarding requirements.
• Maintain and update compliance logs, risk registers, and action plans.
• Support the preparation and submission of regulatory documentation, including Provider Information Returns, notifications, audits, and evidence for CQC inspections.
• Coordinate internal compliance audits across branches and teams.
• Support incident, complaint, and safeguarding investigations through data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Data Analysis & Reporting
• Collect, cleanse, validate, and analyse operational and quality data: client outcomes, visit punctuality and continuity of care, medication administration errors, staff training compliance, recruitment and retention metrics, care concerns, incidents and risk alerts
• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports (monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc) for senior leadership.
• Identify trends, patterns, and emerging risks through data analysis and visualisation.
• Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across systems and reports.
Quality Improvement
• Support quality assurance processes, including audits and staff competency reviews.
• Design, implement, and monitor quality improvement initiatives with the senior leadership team.
• Track progress against improvement plans.
Systems & Data Management
• Manage and optimise data management systems; ensure accurate and timely data entry.
• Support and train staff on systems, data recording standards, and compliance requirements.
• Maintain GDPR-compliant processes for data security, access, and retention.
• Identify opportunities to improve data systems, reporting processes, and data quality.
Essential Skills & Experience
• Experience in a data, compliance, quality, or auditing role, preferably within health or social care
• Strong understanding of Care Quality Commission regulations and quality standards.
• Excellent analytical skills, with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g. Excel).
• Ability to interpret complex data and communicate insights clearly.
• High attention to detail.

• Experience handling confidential and sensitive information in line with GDPR.
Desirable Skills & Experience

Qualifications

About the Department / Programme

What you'll be doing

• Current and future process models, journeys, scenarios and acceptance criteria.

Key Experience & Skills

• Experience in automotive finance, consumer lending, asset finance, leasing or another regulated lending environment.
• Strong process analysis, process mapping, current-state / future-state assessment and gap analysis.
• Strong business, functional and non-functional requirements definition, prioritisation and traceability.
• Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviewing and senior stakeholder management.
• Experience contributing to Target Operating Models.

Junior Data Analyst
Make data count in the fight against water leakage
Join Tetra Tech as a Junior Data Analyst on a 12-month fixed-term contract and help turn network data into practical action to reduce water loss.

Purpose and scope of the role
Based in Nelson, you'll support Tetra Tech's Dwr Cymru Welsh Water contract by analysing recordings from leakage monitoring systems. Working with Acoustic Loggers, Leakage Engineers and the Delivery Team, you'll monitor assets through web-based software, identify likely leak locations and prepare reports and operational packs for field teams. You'll also contribute to client meetings, leakage event planning and continuous improvement.
No previous water industry experience is required; training will be provided.

Your impact in this position
Your analysis will help field teams prioritise resources and locate leaks efficiently. During the 12-month contract, you'll build your technical and industry knowledge and may take on greater responsibility across monitoring systems, data integration and project delivery.
Tetra Tech supports learning and development through personal development plans, training and clear career pathways, with opportunities to contribute to significant infrastructure projects.

Core capabilities
• Data analysis and IT - Confidently interpret monitoring data, integrate information from different systems and use Microsoft 365 and work management applications.
• Communication and collaboration - Share clear, accurate information in writing and in conversation, and work effectively with technical colleagues, delivery teams and clients.
• Customer focus - Bring a strong service ethos and help colleagues use field resources effectively.
• Planning and delivery - Manage targets and deadlines, prepare accurate operational packs and support leakage event responses.
• Adaptability and continuous improvement - Be open to learning, identify opportunities to improve processes and systems, and respond flexibly to changing operational needs.

Skills, qualifications and experience
This role would suit an early-career data analyst or recent graduate. Experience in utilities or water distribution is desirable, but not essential. You'll need a full UK driving licence and access to your own transport. Training will be provided; no specific qualification is stated as essential.

Work patterns and location
The role is based at Tetra Tech's Nelson office and is a 12-month fixed-term contract, working 40 hours per week, normally between 07:30 and 15:30.
The position involves office-based work and may require additional days, outdoor work in all weather, occasional night work and moving heavy items, including manhole covers. Hybrid or remote working is not specified. Mandatory drugs and alcohol testing applies. Tetra Tech can make reasonable adjustments during recruitment and in the workplace.

Why join Tetra Tech?
Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees.
In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements.

jd_full:
Ready for a challenge?
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role
We're looking for a Mid-level Product Analyst / Analytics Engineer to join our analytics team, focused on our Post Order Help Experience. When something goes wrong with an order, more and more customers get help from our AI agentic chat, which understands their issue and resolves it end to end.
This is a genuinely hybrid role, split roughly evenly between analysis and analytics engineering. You'll measure whether our AI agents truly solve customers' problems and what that means for their trust and loyalty. You'll also build the trusted data models, evaluation datasets and metric layer that make this measurement possible.
You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, UX, customer service operations and fellow analysts and data engineers.
Location: Hybrid - 3 days a week from our London or Berlin office & 2 days working from home
Reporting to: Manager, Product Analytics

Agentic resolution & AI quality
• Own the scorecard: define, track and report on agentic resolution and customer outcome metrics (e.g. reorder rate, contact propensity, CSAT) across intents and markets.
• Raise the bar on AI quality: build and maintain evaluation frameworks and golden datasets for our AI agents, combining quantitative signals with conversation-level quality reviews.

Experimentation & insight
• Test, learn, repeat: design and analyse experiments on help journeys and the AI chat, from hypothesis and sample size to a clear recommendation.
• Shape the roadmap: turn conversation, ticket and order data into insights that influence Post Order Experience priorities, and present them clearly to PMs and senior stakeholders.

Analytics engineering
• Build the foundations: design clean, well-documented data models (e.g. Kimball) with dbt and SQL for conversation, turn-level, evaluation and ticket data.
• Engineer it properly: apply software engineering practices to analytics, including Git, code review, automated testing and CI/CD.
• Keep data trustworthy: build and maintain reliable pipelines with Airflow and dbt, with data quality checks.
• One source of truth: maintain a governed semantic layer and metric definitions connected to Tableau and/or Looker.

Collaboration
• Break down silos: partner with engineering and data engineering to define tracking and logging (e.g. Snowplow events) for new AI features.
• Move fast with AI: use AI tools in your own workflow to work smarter, and help the team adopt them responsibly.

What will you bring to the table?
• Strong experience as a Product Analyst, Analytics Engineer or in a similar data role, ideally on an e-commerce product.
• Expert-level SQL and hands-on experience building production data models with dbt (or a similar tool).
• Solid understanding of dimensional data modelling, data warehousing and cloud data platforms (e.g. BigQuery / GCP).
• Experience with Git-based workflows, testing and CI/CD for data; experience with Airflow or another orchestrator is a plus.
• Hands-on Python for data analysis and statistics.
• A proven experimentation background: hypothesis formulation, sample size, statistical significance and interpretation.
• Experience building dashboards and semantic layers in Tableau and/or Looker.
• Curiosity about AI products; experience measuring chatbots, conversational AI or LLM output quality is a big plus.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences.
• An ownership mindset.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. Career site: careers.justeattakeaway.com

Salary: £55k-£83k per year (Glassdoor estimate, not employer provided).

We are looking for an Analyst to join our growing environmental policy practice. We provide support to the research, development and evaluation of environmental policy, working with UK Government departments (e.g. Defra) and agencies as well as the European Commission (e.g. DG Environment).
Much of our work involves economic analysis and evaluation of public policies, programmes and contexts across:
• Protected areas and conservation
• Green economy

In the EU: economic benefits of marine protected areas, the EU Business and Biodiversity Platform, marine habitat assessments, and evaluation of the animal welfare strategy.

From day one, you will contribute to a diverse range of assignments by undertaking qualitative and quantitative research and analysis that impacts directly on public policy decisions, with training, career guidance, mentoring and communities of practice.

jd_full:
Commercial Analyst, Pricing & Proposition (12-month FTC)
Ever looked at a set of numbers and seen the commercial opportunity hiding behind them? If you're someone who enjoys turning data into decisions, this could be the role for you. Reporting to the Proposition & Pricing Director, you'll join us on a 12-month FTC based at 70 St Mary Axe, London, working in a hybrid pattern with three days in the office each week and regular visits across our brands.
At Lomond Group, one of the UK's largest and fastest-growing property services groups, you'll help shape the pricing and proposition decisions that influence performance across our lettings brands. This role sits at the heart of commercial decision-making, turning landlord, property and fee data into recommendations that drive growth, strengthen propositions and help our brands make better-informed decisions with confidence.
What you'll be doing
• Building and maintaining a clear group-wide view of fees across brands, branches and the wider business.
• Identifying pricing opportunities through robust analysis and assessing both commercial value and likelihood of success.
• Modelling pricing changes, promotions and offers to understand break-even points and potential returns.
• Creating evidence-based insight into how pricing influences wins, losses and conversion performance.
• Sizing and evaluating proposition opportunities, including packaged services and new revenue streams.
• Using customer segmentation to help branches target the right landlords with the right propositions.
• Supporting longer-term commercial initiatives through retention, share of wallet and customer behaviour analysis.
• Producing monthly performance reporting on fee changes, service uptake, churn and commercial outcomes.
• Measuring the effectiveness of launches and trials and providing clear recommendations on what works.
• Creating high-quality presentations and papers for senior stakeholders including brand MDs and ExCo, clearly communicating methods, assumptions and recommendations.
What you'll need
• Experience in a commercial, pricing, revenue or insight analyst role.
• Strong SQL skills with the ability to work independently with large transactional datasets.
• Advanced Excel skills, including modelling, scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
• Strong commercial judgement with the confidence to distinguish meaningful trends from noise.
• The ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to senior stakeholders through reports, presentations and recommendations.
• A detail-oriented approach with a strong focus on data accuracy, validation and reconciliation.
Here's what you can look forward to
• 28 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays
• A pension scheme
• Car Salary Sacrifice Scheme
• Enhanced Family Friendly Leave
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Competitive base pay benchmarked to market, plus commission & performance bonuses on most roles
• Funded professional qualifications
If you'd like to be considered, apply through our careers site. Our recruitment process consists of a first-stage conversation with the TA team followed by a second-stage interview with the Hiring Manager.
The closing date for applications is 16th December 2026.

Salesforce Business Analyst - Vista Global, London
This is not a traditional requirements-gathering role. • Explore and evaluate AI and automation opportunities, developing practical business cases for adoption.
• Support the testing and validation of new solutions before release.
• Measure the success of delivered improvements and identify further optimisation opportunities.
• Act as a trusted advisor across the organisation, championing continuous improvement and innovation.
Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience
• Experience in Business Analysis, Process Improvement, Business Transformation, Operational Excellence, Consulting, or a similar role.
• An interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with enthusiasm for finding practical applications.
• Experience with Salesforce is beneficial but not essential.

Business Analyst - Connexus, Craven Arms
We're looking for an experienced and customer-focused Business Analyst to help drive strategic and operational change across Connexus. Acting as the bridge between business and technology teams, you'll help shape and deliver change that supports our Corporate Plan.
About the Role
You'll work across a diverse portfolio of strategic, digital and operational change initiatives, supporting Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery approaches. You'll lead process discovery, process mapping and process improvement activities.
Key Responsibilities
• Gather, analyse and document business requirements across a range of projects and change initiatives.
• Facilitate workshops, interviews and stakeholder engagement sessions to understand business needs and desired outcomes.
• Lead process discovery, process mapping and process improvement activities.
• Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, requirement specifications and other business analysis artefacts.
• Support solution evaluation, testing, implementation and business readiness activities.
• Work with project teams to ensure requirements remain traceable throughout the delivery lifecycle.
• Contribute to governance, reporting and continuous improvement activities within the PMO.
• Support Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery methodologies.
• Promote continuous improvement, lessons learned and delivery excellence across the organisation.
You'll bring
• Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting technology, digital or business change initiatives.
• Strong requirements gathering, analysis and documentation skills.
• Experience of process mapping, process improvement and business transformation.
• Deep knowledge and practical application of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery approaches.
• Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and facilitation skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
• Experience supporting testing, implementation and business readiness activities.

We are looking for someone with:
• Experience within an operational MI, reporting, or analytics environment.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills.
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
• The ability to translate business requirements into meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Working for Cabot: Investors in People Gold accredited organisation.

jd_full:
URBN – Junior Analyst. London (European Head Office). Commercial finance team.

About Us
URBN UK Limited is part of the URBN Group, a global retailer, with its European Head Office located in London. Its retail offering in Europe takes the form of three brands. With stores in more than 10 European countries and a strong e-commerce presence.

Role Summary
We are looking for a data-driven individual looking to advance their career in a dynamic, fashion-forward retail environment within a commercial finance team, with a view toward business partnering across functional teams.
As our Junior Analyst you will support two key business areas: workforce management for our UK/EU retail business and management accounts for our third-party channels (franchise and wholesale).
The main objective of this role is to champion financial discipline, challenge existing processes, and build BI and AI solutions that improve how we plan and report. Delivering timely, accurate insights to enable effective, profit-focused business decisions is fundamental to this position.

What You'll Be Doing
Workforce Management
• Support the continued development and implementation of the labour scheduling model in UO, AN and FP across the UK and Europe, working with your line manager, Brand Finance and Retail Operations.
• Own the data in the model: maintain and update inputs, check accuracy and integrity, and generate accurate weekly scheduling hours.
• Progress toward leading the model for two brands (AN and FP, with secondary support for UO as required).
• Deliver timely, value-add reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) covering store payroll performance (hours and spend) against budget and forecast.
• Support the monthly forecast and the annual budgeting cycle, ensuring labour planning aligns with scheduling model outputs and finance objectives across UO, AN and FP.
• Manage the upload of monthly labour hours into the Live Ledger (our financial reporting system), ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
• Improve existing reporting and move Excel-based reports into Qlik, building and maintaining dashboards yourself, and using AI to automate and enhance store-facing reporting.
• Build strong relationships with brand finance and non-finance contacts, explaining model outputs and challenging assumptions where needed.
• Collaborate with the North America team to share best practice and standardise global process efficiencies.
• Act as the key operational liaison between HRIS/BI teams and Workforce Management.
Financial
• Review and validate monthly actuals and calculate month-end accruals for line manager review.
• Produce clear commentary and performance reports (monthly and quarterly) for wholesale and franchise management accounts, from top-line revenue to operating income.
• Support the monthly forecasting cadence, including financial model maintenance and system data uploads.
• Support the annual budgeting and long-range planning (LRP) processes across full channel P&Ls.
• Identify opportunities to streamline reporting cycles through continuous process improvement and better use of systems.
• Provide ad hoc analytical support and cover routine line manager tasks as required.
• Deliver financial analysis and decision support to cross-functional business partners.

What You'll Need
• Passion for developing a career within a fast-paced retail finance environment
• Demonstrated track record of analysing large data sets or a solid background in accounting and commercial finance
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong PowerPoint skills
• Experience with Qlik, or a proven ability to learn and build in a BI tool such as Qlik or Power BI
• Experience with financial systems such as Hyperion HFM, Essbase or MicroStrategy is desirable
• Proven track record of quickly adopting new software tools and reporting platforms
• Strong ability to translate complex financial concepts into clear insights for non-finance partners
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Strong ability to prioritise effectively and manage stakeholder expectations, with a focus on continuous process improvement

The Perks
• Work-life balance: flexible start and finish times, bring your dog to work.
• Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Program, free gym, private medical insurance.
• Employee discount: up to 40% off at all URBN brands.
• Community: one paid day to volunteer or fundraise for a charity.
• Travel: cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan.
• Continued development: structured support and ongoing learning opportunities.

URBN is an Equal Opportunities Employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Pay: not stated by the employer (Glassdoor estimate £35k-£62k).

jd_full:
Business and Research Analyst. Mazon Global Limited, Sunderland.

Overview
As a Business and Research Analyst, you will be responsible for researching the UK construction market, analysing industry trends and identifying commercial opportunities to support the company's strategic growth and business development objectives.
You will gather, evaluate and interpret market, competitor and commercial information to provide evidence-based insights that inform management decisions. Working closely with senior management and relevant stakeholders, you will monitor developments within the construction sector, identify potential projects and tender opportunities, and prepare comprehensive market intelligence reports to support business planning, competitiveness and sustainable growth.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Research the UK construction market, industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging commercial opportunities to identify areas for business growth.
• Analyse competitor activities, market demand, pricing trends and sector performance to assess the company's market position and inform strategic business planning.
• Identify potential construction projects, procurement opportunities, tender opportunities and prospective clients to support business development and market expansion.
• Gather, evaluate and interpret commercial, economic and industry data using appropriate research and analytical methods to identify market patterns and business opportunities.
• Prepare detailed market intelligence reports, research summaries and commercial assessments, presenting findings and recommendations to senior management.
• Monitor changes in the construction industry, including infrastructure investment, housing development, construction costs and market conditions, assessing their potential impact on the business.
• Evaluate market opportunities, assess commercial risks and provide research-based recommendations to support informed management decisions.
• Maintain and develop relevant market research databases, competitor information and industry intelligence to support ongoing business analysis.
• Collaborate with management and relevant stakeholders to identify research requirements, assess business needs and translate findings into practical commercial recommendations.
• Recommend opportunities for business diversification, improved competitiveness and sustainable long-term growth within the UK construction sector.

Qualifications and Experience
Required:
• A degree in Business Management, Business Administration, Economics, Market Research, Project Management or another relevant discipline.
• Demonstrable understanding of business research, market analysis, commercial evaluation and data interpretation.
• Ability to research and analyse industry information, identify market trends and evaluate commercial opportunities.
• Strong analytical, report-writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate research findings clearly.
• Good understanding of the UK construction industry, its commercial environment and market dynamics.
• Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative information and develop evidence-based recommendations.
• Strong organisational, problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills.
Preferred:
• Previous experience in business research, market intelligence, commercial analysis or strategic business analysis.
• Familiarity with construction procurement processes, tendering, project pipelines and commercial opportunities.
• Experience using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau or other business intelligence and data analysis tools.
• Knowledge of construction market information, industry publications, economic indicators and sector research sources.
• Experience preparing market research reports, competitor assessments and commercial opportunity evaluations.

Key Purpose of the Role
The primary purpose of this position is to provide reliable construction-sector market intelligence and commercial research that enables the company to identify new opportunities, understand competitive conditions, make informed strategic decisions and achieve sustainable business growth.

• Work from home

PMO Analyst - HR Transformation Programme, Universities Superannuation Scheme (USS), Liverpool

Business Area: Pensions Solutions and Control
Place of Work: Liverpool
Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract

When you join USS, the size and scale of our pension scheme means you will have numerous opportunities to learn and develop your career. Our office is a vibrant place to work, and we offer flexibility of office/homeworking due to our hybrid model.

About the role
In your role as PMO Analyst - HR Transformation Programme you will provide dedicated PMO leadership and support for the HR Transformation Programme, ensuring robust governance, comprehensive planning, accurate reporting, proactive risk management, and effective delivery support. This role is critical to enabling the successful execution of a complex, multi-year, cross-functional programme.

What you will be doing
As part of the Pensions Solutions and Control team you will be responsible for:
• Producing and maintaining core PMO artefacts (including RAIDs, plans, controls, reports, and analysis).
• Providing continuity for agreed programme coordination, reporting and governance activities during periods of Project Manager absence, within delegated authority and established escalation arrangements.
• Demonstrating a pragmatic, can-do attitude, a willingness to dive into the detail when necessary, and a strong sense of teamwork.

Reporting to the project manager on the HR Transformation Programme, this role encompasses:

Governance & Oversight
• Support the programme and its component parts by understanding the sequence of events and their cross-dependencies, enabling impact analysis if milestones move.
• Maintain comprehensive RAID, decision, and change-control logs, with clear owners, target dates, impacts, mitigations, and escalation routes.
• Co-ordinate and facilitate key governance forums, including scheduling, circulation of materials, recording minutes and tracking actions.
• Coordinate programme change requests and support assessment of impacts on scope, schedule, cost, resources, benefits and dependencies.
• Ensure adherence to change control and approval processes, with a clear audit trail for key artefacts and decisions.

Planning, Scheduling & Management Support
• Maintain and monitor the integrated programme plan, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and key milestones.
• Consolidate milestone trackers from individual workstreams into an overall programme view.
• Ensure programme information is accurately captured in the overarching roadmap.
• Coordinate logistics for cross-functional teams, including scheduling and organising meetings and workshops.

Tracking, Reporting & Insights
• Provide accurate and timely programme reporting (status reports, dashboards and executive updates).
• Prepare high-quality management information packs for senior stakeholders.
• Identify, track and manage risks, issues and dependencies, ensuring mitigating plans are in place.
• Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and items.
• Work with Finance business partners to provide regular budget and forecast updates.

Resource Management
• Support programme resource planning and maintain an integrated view of resource requirements, allocations, gaps and constraints.
• Maintain availability and holiday information for the core programme team and flag potential impacts on delivery milestones.

About you
If you're excited about working for us and have most of the skills or experience we're looking for, please apply, regardless of whether you meet all the requirements.
• Proven experience in PMO or programme support roles within complex, multi-year programmes, ideally within HR, technology or other business transformation programmes.
• A strong understanding of governance frameworks, planning, and risk management.
• Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Advanced proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and project management software.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
• The ability to build effective relationships, constructively challenge information and communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels.
• Proactive and adaptable with a hands-on approach.
• Attention to detail, the ability to work independently, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outputs.

How we will reward you
• Great starting salary
• Generous annual leave package
• Access to a high quality pension scheme provided through USS
• Supportive people policies (enhanced occupational sick pay and family friendly pay)
• Financial contributions towards personal development and wellbeing
• Health and wellbeing services, e.g. private healthcare, discounted gym membership
• Learning and development opportunities
• Employee volunteer days
• Cycle to Work Scheme

About us
Universities Superannuation Scheme (USS) was established in 1974 as the principal pension scheme for universities and other higher education institutions in the UK, working with around 330 employers for almost 599,000 members, with total assets of around £84 billion (March 2026). USSL is an equal opportunity employer and offers reasonable adjustments during recruitment.

jd_full:
PMO Analyst, UBDS Group, London

At UBDS, we help organisations transform through cloud, cyber security, AI and digital innovation. As our PMO & Project Management capability continues to grow, we're looking for experienced PMO Analysts to support the successful delivery of technology and transformation programmes across Government and the wider public sector.

This is a hands-on role combining Project Management Office (PMO), project planning, governance and Project Support Office (PSO) responsibilities. You'll help ensure projects and programmes are effectively planned, monitored and coordinated, providing the structure and information needed to support successful delivery.

Working closely with Project Managers, Programme Managers, Delivery Leads and wider teams, you'll take ownership of defined PMO activities, maintain accurate delivery information and help manage risks, dependencies and priorities.

What You'll Do
• Support PMO activities across technology and transformation projects and programmes.
• Develop, maintain and update project plans, milestones and delivery schedules.
• Support integrated planning, dependency tracking and project scheduling.
• Maintain RAID logs, ensuring risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies are accurately recorded and escalated.
• Produce project and programme status reports, dashboards and management information.
• Support project governance, including steering committees, delivery boards and assurance activities.
• Track progress against agreed milestones, deliverables and project plans.
• Identify emerging delivery risks, planning conflicts and issues, escalating where appropriate.
• Support project financial tracking, resource planning and reporting.
• Maintain project documentation, action logs, decision records and governance artefacts.
• Coordinate meetings, planning sessions and project reviews.
• Support project mobilisation, delivery and closure activities.
• Work with delivery teams to ensure project information remains accurate and up to date.
• Follow up actions and support the resolution of outstanding project activities.
• Contribute to improvements in PMO processes, reporting and project controls.
• Communicate project updates, risks and actions to relevant stakeholders.

What We're Looking For
We're interested in candidates with experience across one or more of the following areas:

PMO & Governance
• Supporting PMO processes, reporting and project governance.
• Maintaining RAID logs, action trackers and decision records.
• Producing management information and project status reports.
• Supporting project financials, resource tracking and delivery performance.
• Coordinating governance meetings and maintaining project documentation.

Project & Programme Planning
• Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones and delivery schedules.
• Tracking dependencies across projects or workstreams.
• Monitoring project progress and identifying potential scheduling issues.
• Supporting integrated planning and delivery forecasting.
• Using project planning tools to maintain accurate schedules and reporting.

Project Support Office (PSO)
• Coordinating project activities, meetings and documentation.
• Maintaining project records and delivery trackers.
• Supporting project mobilisation and resource coordination.
• Tracking actions and following up with stakeholders.
• Providing day-to-day coordination and support to Project and Programme Managers.

Essential Experience
• Experience within PMO, Project Planning, Project Coordination or Project Support roles.
• Good understanding of project governance, reporting and delivery controls.
• Experience maintaining project plans, milestones and dependencies.
• Experience managing RAID logs and tracking project actions.
• Ability to produce accurate project reports and management information.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Experience working with Project Managers, delivery teams and stakeholders.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of defined PMO activities.
• Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

Employee Benefits
• Training and personal development options
• Private medical cover for you and your spouse/partner (Vitality)
• Discretionary bonus based on personal and company performance
• 25 days holiday, plus birthday and work anniversary days, plus UK bank holidays
• Electric vehicle leasing with salary sacrifice
• Contributed pension scheme
• Death in service cover

UBDS Group is an equal opportunities employer.

jd_full:
Junior BI Analyst
Starting salary up to £26,000 | 30-hour working week | January 2027 start
Join BW Legal's Business Intelligence and Management Information (BI/MI) team and turn your analytical skills into insight that helps the business make better decisions. You'll work on real business challenges: investigating trends, improving reporting and helping automate processes, contributing to projects from initial requirements through to delivery, with guidance from the team.
A fast-paced role for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership and wants to develop quickly. You don't need to arrive knowing everything; you do need curiosity, sound analytical foundations and the drive to keep improving.

What you'll be doing
• Responding to ad-hoc data requests from stakeholders, clarifying the question and presenting accurate, useful findings.
• Gathering user requirements and helping create reporting and management information that answers real business needs.
• Supporting the maintenance and improvement of SQL-based business process automation.
• Investigating anomalies, checking data quality and helping resolve issues to improve confidence in reporting.
• Maintaining existing MI reporting and supporting accurate, timely delivery for internal and external customers.
• Analysing operational and financial data to uncover trends and explain what they mean for the business.
• Building relationships across departments, communicating progress and helping colleagues get more value from BI and MI.
• Learning to build end-to-end extract, transform and load (ETL) processes, with support from experienced colleagues.

What you'll bring
• A degree in a relevant analytical subject, such as maths, physics, computer science or engineering, or equivalent training or practical experience working with data.
• Strong numerical and logical reasoning, attention to detail and an investigative approach to solving problems.
• Experience using a coding language such as R, Python or MATLAB to process or analyse data. University, personal and work-based projects are all relevant.
• Clear communication skills and confidence to ask questions and work across departments.
• Ability to organise your work, adapt when priorities change and maintain accuracy at pace.
• Resilience, openness to feedback and willingness to seek support.
• A proactive attitude to learning.
Tell us about a project where you used data or code to investigate a problem, what you did and what you learnt.

Useful, but not essential
• Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and querying data using T-SQL.
• Additional experience of data processing or analysis using code.
• Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables and charts.

Working pattern and pay
• Six hours a day, 9am-3pm or 10am-4pm, Monday to Friday.
• Starting salary up to £26,000 depending on experience, with salary reviews.

Benefits (summary)
• 23 days' leave plus bank holidays, birthday, Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve; flexible holiday policy
• Attendance bonus, death in service cover, income protection, contributory pension
• Learning and development allowance, study support for professional qualifications
• Free parking, gym membership, on-site GP and physiotherapist, health cash plan
BW Legal is a Disability Confident employer.

RGA is a purpose-driven organisation working to solve today's challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 company, it is the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions.

A Brief Overview
To ensure UK and Continental Europe (CE) Treaty and Facultative premium accounts are administered appropriately and accurately in line with treaty specifications.
Your responsibilities will cover the UK and CE markets. Additionally, your expertise may be leveraged in other RGA entities or affiliates outside UK and CE as resources permit.

• Strong IT proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Excel.

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.

What you can expect from RGA
• Knowledge and experience from diverse colleagues around the world.
• A respectful, welcoming environment.
• Career potential.

jd_full:
IN SHORT
Working with the Credit team you will assess and review counterparties' creditworthiness and KYC status, recommending and monitoring counterparty credit limits, and managing credit exposures. As a business partner to Front Office, you will develop a strong professional and trustworthy relationship communicating sound credit opinions in a convincing, understandable and concise manner. This role is for a 6 month Fixed Term Contract.

WHAT WILL YOU DO
Communicating sound credit opinions in a convincing, understandable and concise manner to non-credit stakeholders is key for success. Your ability to find innovative solutions which address risk reduction whilst responding to commercial requirements will make you stand out. You will also be responsible for:
• Analyse counterparties' credit worthiness, primarily through analysis of their financial statements, in order to recommend appropriate credit limits.
• Monitor credit exposure and risk measures continuously in anticipation and management of potential breaches and exceptions. Pro-actively assessing exposure and the impact of potential transactions to provide advisory support to Front Office.
• Developing and maintaining positive relationships with counterparties' credit departments to maximise the credit lines granted to SEFE. Support in negotiating trading documentation.
• Analyse counterparties' KYC status under the company's established assessment process, in order to recommend an appropriate KYC status. Regular renewal and continuous monitoring of KYC status for our counterparties.
• Attend to daily reporting and external margining requirements, including contacting counterparties, dispute resolution, and follow up.
• Input and maintenance of related credit and KYC data in the database.

WHAT WILL YOU BRING
Your previous experience in a Credit Risk, Credit Analysis, or Risk Management role within an energy company, commodity trading house, bank, or rating agency is essential. Knowledge of energy and commodity trading markets is beneficial. You will have:
• Deep understanding of Credit Risk Management principles, including credit assessment, counterparty analysis, exposure measurement, and risk mitigation within commodity trading environments.
• Proven experience assessing counterparties and managing credit risk associated with physical and financial commodity transactions.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to develop well-reasoned, data-driven credit recommendations and present complex risk assessments in a clear and concise manner.
• Ability to identify market trends, emerging risks, and key industry developments across energy and commodity markets and communicate actionable insights to senior management.
• Solid understanding of KYC onboarding, customer due diligence, and counterparty assessment processes.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across trading, risk, finance, and commercial teams.

ABOUT US
SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions across the entire energy value chain, from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

OUR BENEFITS
This is a contract role, initially for 6 months with the potential to extend. Based in our London office, close to travel networks, with a hybrid working model.

Base pay: £42k - £61k/yr (Glassdoor Est.)

jd_full:
Strategic Data Analyst - Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity
We're looking for a Strategic Data Analyst to join our growing Insight & Performance team. You'll work on projects from forecasting and predictive modelling to supporter lifetime value, audience insight and understanding what drives engagement, helping move beyond reporting what happened to understanding why and what to do next.
We're looking for someone with strong SQL and analytical skills, a curious mind and the ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations.

Salary
£42,700 per annum; hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days per week in the office. Salaries are not offered above the advertised rate.

Key Responsibilities
• Deliver strategic analysis that helps Fundraising and Marketing teams understand performance, identify opportunities and make informed decisions.
• Develop forecasts, predictive models and segmentation approaches to understand supporter behaviour, lifetime value and opportunities for growth.
• Analyse fundraising campaigns and audience performance, identifying trends, risks and opportunities.
• Work with stakeholders across the charity to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Use insight to support business planning, investment decisions and prioritisation of fundraising activity.
• Evaluate campaigns and experiments.
• Work closely with Selections, Reporting and Data Engineering colleagues to improve audience targeting.
• Explore new analytical techniques and approaches.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• Strong SQL skills, with experience analysing and interrogating complex datasets.
• Experience delivering analysis that informs business decisions.
• Experience developing analytical models, forecasts, segmentation or predictive approaches.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience working with CRM data and analytical tools to understand customer, supporter or audience behaviour.
• Experience using data visualisation tools such as Power BI.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• A curious and proactive approach.
• Experience working with fundraising or supporter data.

DBS: a basic DBS check is required.
How to apply: short application form via the apply button. Closing date: 2 December 2026; applications reviewed on an ongoing basis and the role may close early.
Benefits: 30 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, flexible working, enhanced pension, life assurance, health and wellbeing schemes.
